TITLE: Words We Never Spoke
STYLE: Singer-songwriter folk, acoustic guitar, subtle piano, upright bass, brushed drums, close unpolished intimate vocal, sparse reflective atmosphere, 85 BPM
LYRICS:
[Intro]
Style is everything they told me
Just the quiet in the room

[Verse]
I rehearsed the words all week
The careful way I'd start

[Chorus]
If I had just said it then
Before the silence grew so wide

[Outro]
Still lingering now
ARTWORK: A single bare tree standing against a pale, washed-out sky.
